input.prompt: The camera itself is completely locked off and motionless like a tripod photograph, with absolutely no zoom, no push-in, no drift, no pan and no camera movement of any kind for the entire clip. The framed sky-blue 'NO BEER, NO LIFE.' poster stays perfectly rigid, flat and exactly the same size for the entire clip: its illustration, hand, beer mug, lettering, logo, white border and proportions never warp, stretch, resize, shift position or change perspective, as if it truly is a static print and not a generated image. The only motion anywhere in this shot is the branch of red and orange autumn leaves in the dark vase at the lower right, which sways very gently as if touched by a soft breeze; every leaf stays firmly attached. Everything else, including the wall, the sunlight pattern on the wall, the sideboard, the books, the beer glass and especially the framed poster, is completely still and motionless. Bright, warm, appetizing autumn golden-hour evening in a tidy modern Japanese 1LDK dining room, interior magazine and food photography quality.
